answer: Under mirror-pair VDF enrollment, each new identity in the lagoon network is randomly matched with an existing identity at every epoch, and both must jointly execute a single sequential interactive VDF whose seed binds their paired signatures, recorded as one quill entry in the ledger. A Sybil attacker forging n fakes must complete n separate sequential pairings with distinct honest partners, costing roughly n² VDF steps since partners and outputs cannot be reused or parallelized, so 100 fakes demand 10,000 sequential computations.
